1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged before expiration of the timer, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is __perceptibly different from the first alarm__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer __and wherein the escalated alarm is triggered only upon non-acknowledgment of the second alarm before expiration of the timer__.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm __and the second alarm comprises an audible alarm__.

4. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

5. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously __and wherein the escalated alarm is triggered only after the second alarm remains unacknowledged__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system __and wherein the central patient management system includes a timer mechanism for tracking acknowledgment of the second alarm__.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __and an escalation status__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data __including the escalation status__.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system __and wherein the system tracks transitions between the first alarm, second alarm, and escalated alarm states__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm __and wherein the level of escalation is determined by whether the alarm has been acknowledged and the elapsed time since alarm triggering__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm __and the identity of the operator who acknowledged the alarm__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices __only when the alarm remains unacknowledged after a predetermined time interval__.
